subject: Launch incentive and volume rebate proposal

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: Launch incentives for 6mo POC

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising and the team is excited to move forward with a time-boxed POC aligned to our product launch in Q1. A few questions from product/procurement on how Redwood typically handles commercial launch incentives: 

- We expect to consume ~120M tokens/month during the 3-month pilot and then spike to ~600M/month during a three-month soft launch period. Can you share any standard "launch" packages you offer that combine upfront credits + per-token discounts for short-term commitments?
- Procurement prefers a simple invoicing cadence (net 60) and would like to see a PO template or procurement checklist.
- Would Redwood be open to a marketing co-sell mention (customer quote + joint blog) in exchange for a larger up-front credit tied to committing to a minimum spend over the first 6 months?

I attached our high-level forecast for the POC so you have numbers to work against (lumina-usage-forecast.xlsx). Looking for a short commercial proposal so we can queue this for our procurement review next week.

Best,
Claire
Claire Holden
Head of Product, Lumina AI

Attachment: lumina-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Holden <c.holden@lumina.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Launch incentives for 6mo POC

Hi Claire — really appreciate the forecast and the close follow-up. We can absolutely structure a launch package that mixes an upfront credit with a temporary per-token rebate to smooth your ramp. High-level proposal below (can formalize in a short DocuSign SOW when you're ready):

1) Pilot onboarding credit
   - $40k platform credit applied to first 3 months (covers tooling, initial usage, and priority onboarding).
2) Short-term launch rebate (months 4–6)
   - Base hosted API price with a tiered rebate applied monthly:
     * 0–250M tokens: standard price
     * 250M–1B tokens: 8% rebate
     * >1B tokens: 12% rebate
   - Rebate applies only to token usage above the lower tier.
3) Commitment incentive
   - If Lumina signs a 6-month minimum committment (expected 6-month committed spend >= $120k), we increase the upfront credit by $20k (total $60k) and guarantee the 12% rebate threshold lowers to >800M tokens.
4) Marketing co-sell
   - We are open to a joint blog and quote; if Lumina agrees, we'll accelerate the $20k additional credit to be effective at PO execution.
5) Commercial mechanics
   - Invoicing: monthly usage invoiced Net 60 (we'll accept PO).
   - Termination: POC can be terminated with 30 days notice, committed discount applies only if the minimum spend threshold is hit.

I've attached a short draft that shows the math across the tiers (proposal-draft.pdf). If this structure looks reasonable, can we schedule a 30-min call with procurement next Tue or Wed to confirm PO and invoicing details?

Thanks — happy to iterate.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Sergio / Aditya — quick internal note on the proposal above.

- Margin check: the $60k upfront plus the temporary rebate will be fine if we set a hard floor on blended unit price for the six months. I'd prefer a min effective rate of $0.0009/token across committed dollars to avoid churn losses during the spike.
- Legal: need procurement to sign PO + SOW; no changes to our standard data handling terms for the marketing co-sell ask (we can do a short quote but no quoted customer data sharing aside from what Claire approves).
- Finance: loop Marissa for any revenue recognition/credit timing concerns.

I'll greenlight outreach to procurement once legal checks the SOW.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
